function withDefault(x?: number = 2) {
  return x;
}
console.log(withDefault());

  constructor(public n?: number = 5) {}
  scale(factor?: number = 1) {
    return factor;
  }
}
const arrow = (y?: number = 1) => y;
const expression = function (z?: string = '') {
  return z;
};

function thenRequired(a?: number = 1, b: number) {}
type Callback = (q?: number = 1) => void;
interface Shape {
  area(q?: number = 1): void;
}
function destructured({ a }?: { a: number } = { a: 1 }) {}

  a?: number,
  b?: number = 3,
) {}
